import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 21;
    static final double EPSILON = 1e-6;
    static int total_count = 0, k_target, total_m;
    static double[] probabilities = new double[MAXN];
    static int[] indices = new int[MAXN];
    static double[] final_ans = new double[MAXN];
    static double[] dp_mask = new double[1 << MAXN];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        total_m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k_target = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < total_m; i++) {
            double val = Double.parseDouble(st.nextToken());
            if (val > EPSILON) {
                probabilities[total_count] = val;
                indices[total_count] = i;
                total_count++;
            } else {
                final_ans[i] = 0.0;
            }
        }

        if (k_target >= total_count) {
            for (int i = 0; i < total_count; i++) {
                final_ans[indices[i]] = 1.0;
            }
        } else {
            Arrays.fill(dp_mask, 0.0);
            dp_mask[0] = 1.0;
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << total_count); mask++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(mask) < k_target) {
                    double sum_prob = 0.0;
                    for (int t = 0; t < total_count; t++) {
                        if (((mask >> t) & 1) == 0) {
                            sum_prob += probabilities[t];
                        }
                    }
                    if (sum_prob > 0) {
                        for (int t = 0; t < total_count; t++) {
                            if (((mask >> t) & 1) == 0) {
                                int next_mask = mask ^ (1 << t);
                                double prob = probabilities[t] / sum_prob;
                                dp_mask[next_mask] += prob * dp_mask[mask];
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << total_count); mask++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == k_target) {
                    for (int t = 0; t < total_count; t++) {
                        if (((mask >> t) & 1) == 1) {
                            final_ans[indices[t]] += dp_mask[mask];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < total_m; i++) {
            sb.append(final_ans[i]).append(" ");
        }
        System.out.println(sb.toString().trim());
    }
}
